item.title: Clean the pavements, 24th August
item.description:
• Please give brief details of your complaint or compliment below: We have lived in Bromley for over 21 years and have sadly seen the decline in street cleaning in the High Street. It has now reached an all-time low and the pavements can only be described as filthy. While I appreciate that there are sometimes street cleaning assistants steaming gum off the pavements, that does not remove the rest of the dirt. It deteriorates even more the further down the High Street to Bromley South Station. I have, this year, travelled to Switzerland and Italy in a pair of trainers that were not as dirty on the bottom upon my return as a pair of shoes worn to walk into Bromley High Street once and I feel forced to clean the soles etc every time I come home. It would be nice to make Bromley High Street a place to be proud of but currently, it is an embarrassment. Please clean it up! Thank you. Regards, Karen Lindley-Watson • What action (if any) would you like us to take? Clean the pavements
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 130, High Street, Plaistow, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
